title: Spurious Correlations and Beyond: Understanding and Mitigating Shortcut Learning in SDOH Extraction with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting controlled ablation experiments by removing mentions of alcohol or smoking from clinical notes to measure changes in the False Positive Rate (FPR) of drug use predictions, demonstrating models' reliance on superficial clinical cues.
Comparing the False Positive Rates (FPR) of drug use predictions across male and female patient cohorts using linked demographic data to identify systematic disparities in model misclassifications.
